design_rationale: Development-only closed-loop gate with one parcel per grasp family. PI0.5 selects the mode and emits absolute base and bimanual actions; deterministic release is permitted, while expert motion, blending, deadline handoff, and recovery offsets are forbidden.

episodes.task_text: Pick up the parcel, transport it to the marked destination, place it safely, and release it.

admission_policy: Run only after the absolute-v1 common-seed route/action screen passes. Every rollout requires correct VLA mode, complete pick-transport-place, selected scale 1 at every policy step, expert reference false, fallback 0, emergency stop 0, deadline handoff false, and no force violation.
claim_boundary: Development-only gate. These episodes cannot be counted in the frozen 105-rollout result or added to training labels unless a separately verified self-evolution protocol admits a successful trajectory.
